subject: Request: Waive onboarding surcharge for Viridian pilot
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@viridianhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@viridianhealth.com
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding surcharge waiver for pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward with a 3-month pilot focused on clinical note summarization. Before we lock dates, procurement asked if Redwood can waive the one-time onboarding surcharge and apply a simplified rate tier for the pilot (we're targeting ~150k tokens/mo).

Key asks from our side: 
- Waive the $18k onboarding surcharge OR convert to a credit applied to first invoice
- Apply pilot tier pricing (pilot tier = 25% below retail) for the first 90 days
- Defer invoicing for the first 30 days while we complete SOC/technical onboarding

I attached a redline of the SOW for context (Viridian_SOW_v3.pdf). We need a short written exception memo that our procurement team can file with finance. Can you confirm whether this is possible and who we should expect to sign?

Appreciate it — Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Director, Clinical AI
Viridian Health
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@viridianhealth.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding surcharge waiver for pilot

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the SOW and the clear ask. I’m looping in Marcus and Marissa to confirm internal approval path. Quick summary from our side:

What Viridian asked for:
- Full waiver of the $18,000 onboarding surcharge OR application of the surcharge as a credit
- Pilot tier pricing across first 90 days (target 150k tokens/mo)
- 30-day billing deferment

My recommended commercial compromise to move quickly:
- Waive the onboarding surcharge in exchange for a 6-month minimum commitment at pilot-tier pricing (we’d credit first invoice equal to the surcharge instead of voiding it).
- Pilot tier pricing for the first 90 days, then transition to standard tier unless we hit the 6-month commitment threshold.
- Approve a 30-day billing deferment limited to onboarding costs only (network/security fees invoiced upon completion of SOC checks).

I’ve attached a short commercial summary (commercial_summary.xlsx) with expected ARR impact under a few scenarios. If Marcus/Marissa are comfortable with the structure, can someone prepare a short exception memo that we can route to VP/CFO for sign-off? Alyssa — if that path works, I’ll get the memo started and send it back for your procurement team to attach to the SOW.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Apr 9, 2028 at 09:12 AM Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@viridianhealth.com> wrote:
> (quoted earlier message and SOW)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding surcharge waiver for pilot

Thanks Naomi — I reviewed the numbers. I support waiving the onboarding charge under a narrow guardrail to avoid normalizing deep one-off concessions. Proposed guardrail:

1) Waive onboarding surcharge (converted to a credit on first invoice) if Viridian signs the 6-month minimum commitment at pilot-tier pricing.
2) Add a 12% price uplift to renewal/extension to offset concession (documented in amendment).
3) Any waiver value above $50k requires explicit VP/CFO approval; Marissa, please verify projected waived amount under the final SOW.

Rationale: this preserves momentum for the pilot while protecting revenue through a minimum commitment and documented renewal uplift. If procurement needs the waiver as an unconditional write-off for their internal policies, we should escalate.

Naomi — please prepare the one-page exception memo with: deal id, waived value estimate, business rationale, and recommended approval path. Marissa — can you run the revenue impact and confirm whether this crosses the $50k threshold?

-Marcus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

> On Mon, Apr 9, 2028 at 11:03 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> > (commercial summary attached)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding surcharge waiver for pilot

Thanks — I ran the numbers against the SOW. Estimated waived value if we convert the onboarding surcharge to a credit: $18,000 now, with ~ $72,000 revenue impact modeled over 12 months under the pilot-onboard-to-renew scenario (assumes pilot converts at 40% to paid tier and average usage scales).

Conclusion / next steps: 
- Because the downstream revenue delta exceeds $50k in our model, this requires VP/CFO sign-off per policy.
- I drafted an exception memo for that signoff (exception_memo_viridian_for_cfo.docx) — Naomi, please add the business rationale paragraph and the signature line for procurement, then I’ll route to finance leadership for approval.
- Legal should prepare a short amendment that: converts the onboarding fee to a credit, codifies the 6-month minimum, and specifies the 12% renewal uplift.

I’ll prepare the routing: finance will review; if approved, we’ll return the memo to Viridian procurement for countersignature. Naomi, Marcus — if you want, I can draft the slightly modified SOW language for the amendment once legal chimes in.

-Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
